settings.question: Will I feel it like caffeine?
settings.answer: No. There is no stimulant in lockin, so there is no lift and no drop. What most people notice is the absence of the afternoon dip rather than a spike in the morning.

settings.question: How long until it does anything?
settings.answer: NAD+ support is cumulative, not immediate. Give it the full 30 days before you judge it. Vitamin C and B12 act sooner, but they are the smaller part of the formula.

settings.question: Can I take it at night?
settings.answer: Yes. No caffeine means a late dose will not affect your sleep. Ashwagandha is often taken in the evening for exactly that reason.

settings.question: Why foils instead of a bottle?
settings.answer: NR and vitamin C degrade on contact with air. An opened bottle gets weaker every time you open it. A sealed foil per dose means day thirty is as strong as day one.

settings.question: Who should not take it?
settings.answer: Not for use if pregnant, nursing, or under 18. Ashwagandha can interact with thyroid and sedative medications — talk to your physician before starting if either applies to you.
